learned: 2026-10-05, by hand: the brand site is a one-page Squarespace with no products; its manufacturer, All In One Extracting & Product Manufacturing (NY license OCM-AUCP-22-000001, linked from the brand site's footer), runs this wholesale Shopify. 41 products, 12 with vendor 'Head Space'.
notes: A wholesale store: the other vendors (Mind Melters, Dealer Cannabis Co., Pure Vibe, Hysteria) are the manufacturer's other brands and are skipped by vendor. Prices are wholesale, and a 1g single's variant is the order terms ('1g Singles (25 unit minimum - order in increments of 5)'), so the size is read from the title.

Titles are pipe-delimited: 'Head Space Prerolls | <Strain> | 5 x 0.5g (<Type>)', 'Head Space Preroll | <Strain> | 1g (<Type>)', 'Head Space | 1.1g Infused Preroll | <Strain> (<Type>)', 'Head Space | 4g Whole Infused Flower | <Strain> (<Type>)', with spacing slips ('Flower|'). The parenthesized strain type is dropped.
Strains rotate and sold-through SKUs drop out of a wholesale list, so store products missing here (an older strain, the 2.5g infused blunt) are expected and stay as the stores' consensus.

skip.why: another brand of the same manufacturer
